problems.message: class jcsa.cls exists at template/jcsa.cls but TeX only searches the main file's directory and the TeX tree
problems.name: jcsa
problems.hint: Copy template/jcsa.cls next to main.tex (keep the template file unchanged), or set TEXINPUTS=./template//: - copying is more portable.
